reference_sql:
SELECT l.order_line_id, o.order_ts, s.store_code, l.quantity
FROM order_lines l
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.channel = 'store'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-09 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
alternatives: SELECT l.order_line_id, o.order_ts, s.store_code, l.quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.channel = 'store' AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-09'
SELECT s.order_line_id, o.order_ts, s.store_code, s.units FROM sales s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.channel = 'store' AND s.order_date = DATE '2025-03-09'

other_way.sql: SELECT l.order_line_id, o.order_ts, s.store_code, l.quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.channel = 'store' AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-09'
